_disclaimer: ILLUSTRATIVE, synthetic expected-loss assumptions chosen by the author for Module C, Milestone 4 of this learning project. These numbers are NOT a regulatory capital estimate, NOT a CECL/IFRS 9 allowance calculation, NOT a Basel expected-loss figure, and NOT LendingClub's own loss experience. `lgd` is a single configurable scalar, not derived from this dataset's real recoveries/total_rec_prncp columns -- doing so would make it look like a measured historical LGD rather than an illustrative assumption. Change it freely; nothing in this repository treats the resulting Expected Loss numbers as real financial figures.
_ead_definition_note: EAD (exposure at default) is proxied here by `loan_amnt`, an application-time-safe Model A raw feature. Rationale: every loan in this dataset is a closed-end, fully-amortizing installment loan disbursed in full at origination (not a revolving line), so the originally funded amount is a defensible upper bound on what is outstanding at any point in the loan's life -- unlike a revolving product, where EAD can exceed the current balance via an undrawn, re-drawable limit. `loan_amnt` (not `funded_amnt`/`funded_amnt_inv`) is used for consistency with Milestone 3's feature-set discipline, which already dropped the latter two as near-duplicate/collinear with `loan_amnt` (correlation >= 0.999 on the full real file; see docs/credit_risk_model_feature_sets.md).
